newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T's Eagle Star buys Spain's La Suiza.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T's Eagle Star buys Spain's La Suiza.

text.p: B.A.T Industries Plc said on Wednesday that its Eagle Star insurance subsidiary is to buy the Spanish insurance business La Suiza from Switzerland's La Suisse for some 27 million stg.
La Suisse is part of Swiss Life Group.
Eagle Star will buy La Suiza Seguros, the general insurance business and the branch life business of La Suiza Vida.
The provisional purchase price is to be funded out of Eagle Star's own resources, the company said in a statement.
The agreement is subject to Spanish regulatory approval, which is expected in the next few months.
"(The) acquisition represents a major step in our strategy of building Eagle Star's position as a strong competitor in the Spanish market," said Steve Melcher, director of Eagle Star Holdings.
Eagle Star will manage the new businesses alongside its Spanish subsidiaries, Eagle Star Seguros Generales and Eagle Star Vida.
Swiss Life is to continue operating in Spain via its Swiss Life Espana subsidiary.
